review_title: De‐escalation of antimicrobial treatment for adults with sepsis, severe sepsis or septic shock
screening_criteria: We planned to include randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing de‐escalation (based on culture results) versus standard therapy for adults with sepsis, severe sepsis or septic shock. The primary outcome was mortality (at 28 days, hospital discharge or at the end of the follow‐up period). Studies including patients initially treated with an empirical but not adequate antimicrobial therapy were not considered for inclusion.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset labels 1.0 and 0.5 count as INCLUDE; 0.0 counts as EXCLUDE
